name: zzbd_manager_load_entries
description: zZbdManager::LoadEntries creates a write archive, sorts section handlers, invokes pre-load callbacks in sorted order until failure, closes the archive, and returns the final success state.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zUtil ZBD/ZAR manager helper pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja inspection validates the OpenCreateWrite, SortSectionHandlers, InvokePreLoad loop, early stop on callback failure, CloseAndFreeRecords, and returned result contract.
The native smoke verifies sorted callback order, archive close/free cleanup after success, and early termination when the second pre-load callback returns failure.
